crossRefs.note: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
“Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

translations.web: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
translations.bsb: “If only my grief could be weighed and placed with my calamity on the scales.
translations.kjv: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
translations.asv: Oh that my vexation were but weighed, And all my calamity laid in the balances!
